verdict.rationale: Buzz is a chat and collaboration platform, so data retention and deletion controls are a fair axis. The pack documents no retention policies, message or history deletion, or data-purge features. Self-hosting on your own Postgres/S3 and the branch-protection `--no-delete` flag are adjacent capabilities, not retention or deletion controls, and the 'six months of history' search claim describes search scope, not a user-controllable retention setting.
